title: Bridging Research and Industry, SmartAgri UGM Opens INAGRITECH 2025 with Precision Agriculture and Smart Agriculture Innovation

body:
**Jakarta** – Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada participated in INAGRITECH 2025, an international-scale agricultural technology exhibition held on 29–31 July 2025 at JIEXPO Kemayoran, Jakarta. This participation serves as a strategic opportunity for SmartAgri to introduce various campus-based research innovations that support the development of precision agriculture in tropical regions.

On the first day of the exhibition, the SmartAgri booth located at A303-01, Hall A3 became one of the main attractions, showcasing cutting-edge technology in smart farming, ranging from technology in open field horticulture, paddy rice field cultivation, oil palm plantation management, smart greenhouse technology, and plant factory. These innovations were designed to address challenges in the agricultural sector in the digital era, as well as to support efficiency and sustainability of agricultural production from small-scale to industrial operations.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/510-1-img_4875-1030x773.webp)

As part of the exhibition's activity series, the SmartAgri team also had the opportunity to participate in a discussion session titled _"Smart Agriculture Technology and Innovation"_ which was part of the _Agri Technology Forum_. In the session, Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc., a junior lecturer at the Faculty of Agricultural Technology UGM and SmartAgri representative, emphasized the importance of the campus's role in bridging research and the needs of the agricultural industry.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/510-2-img_4821-773x1030.webp)

> "We want to demonstrate that innovations developed on campus do not stop in the laboratory. Through collaboration and downstream development, this technology must be accessible and widely utilized by farmers, MSMEs, and the industrial sector," explained Ardan.

The exhibition also served as a venue for direct interaction between the SmartAgri team and various stakeholders, including students, academics, practitioners, and industry partners. The high enthusiasm of visitors demonstrated that the issue of smart agriculture and digital transformation in the agricultural sector is receiving increasing attention.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/510-3-img_0541-1030x773.webp)

Through its participation in INAGRITECH 2025, SmartAgri UGM reaffirmed its commitment as a center for precision agriculture innovation that is oriented not only toward technology development, but also toward its practical application in supporting food security and community empowerment in tropical regions.

SmartAgri expressed appreciation for the enthusiasm of visitors on the first day and hopes that this event will be the beginning of broader collaboration in the development of campus-based agricultural technology.

original.body:
**Jakarta** – Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada turut ambil bagian dalam pameran teknologi pertanian berskala internasional, INAGRITECH 2025, yang diselenggarakan pada 29–31 Juli 2025 di JIEXPO Kemayoran, Jakarta. Partisipasi ini menjadi ajang strategis bagi SmartAgri dalam memperkenalkan berbagai inovasi berbasis riset kampus yang mendukung pengembangan pertanian presisi di kawasan tropis.

Pada hari pertama pameran, booth SmartAgri yang berlokasi di A303-01, Hall A3 menjadi salah satu daya tarik utama, menampilkan teknologi mutakhir dalam bidang smart farming, mulai dari teknologi pada open field horticulture, paddy rice field cultivation, oil palm plantation management, smart greenhouse technology, dan plant factory. Inovasi-inovasi ini dirancang untuk menjawab tantangan sektor pertanian di era digital, serta mendukung efisiensi dan keberlanjutan produksi pertanian skala kecil hingga industri.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/510-1-img_4875-1030x773.webp)

Sebagai bagian dari rangkaian kegiatan pameran, tim SmartAgri juga berkesempatan untuk tampil dalam sesi diskusi bertajuk _“Smart Agriculture Technology and Innovation”_ yang merupakan bagian dari _Agri Technology Forum_. Dalam sesi tersebut, Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc., dosen muda Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian UGM sekaligus perwakilan SmartAgri, menyampaikan pentingnya peran kampus dalam menjembatani riset dan kebutuhan industri pertanian.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/510-2-img_4821-773x1030.webp)

> “Kami ingin menunjukkan bahwa inovasi yang dikembangkan di kampus tidak hanya berhenti di laboratorium. Melalui kolaborasi dan hilirisasi, teknologi ini harus dapat diakses dan dimanfaatkan secara luas oleh petani, UMKM, maupun sektor industri,” jelas Ardan.

Pameran ini juga menjadi ajang interaksi langsung antara tim SmartAgri dengan berbagai pemangku kepentingan, termasuk pelajar, akademisi, praktisi, serta perwakilan mitra industri. Antusiasme pengunjung yang tinggi menunjukkan bahwa isu pertanian cerdas dan transformasi digital di sektor agrikultur semakin mendapat perhatian luas.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/510-3-img_0541-1030x773.webp)

Melalui keikutsertaan dalam INAGRITECH 2025, SmartAgri UGM menegaskan komitmennya sebagai pusat inovasi pertanian presisi yang tidak hanya berorientasi pada pengembangan teknologi, tetapi juga pada penerapannya secara nyata dalam mendukung ketahanan pangan dan pemberdayaan masyarakat di kawasan tropis.

SmartAgri menyampaikan apresiasi atas antusiasme para pengunjung di hari pertama serta berharap kegiatan ini menjadi awal dari kolaborasi yang lebih luas dalam pengembangan teknologi pertanian berbasis kampus.
